name: Sydney, Australia 🇦🇺
subtitle: Harbour city dining — from Quay to Saint Peter
items: Quay (Peter Gilmore, Circular Quay, 3-hat — snow egg, Opera House view)
Tetsuya's (Kent St, Tetsuya Wakuda, French-Japanese — the degust that defined Sydney)
Aria (Matt Moran, Circular Quay, 2-hat — the reliable grand table)
Saint Peter (Josh Niland, Paddington, 2-hat — fish butchery as a philosophy, James Beard level)
Rockpool Bar & Grill (CBD, Neil Perry — the steak to reference)
Icebergs Dining Room (Bondi Beach, Maurice Terzini — the view alone deserves it)
Sixpenny (Stanmore, Daniel Puskas — the quiet great, produce-driven)
Nomad (Surry Hills, Rebecca Fanning — wood-fired Mediterranean, natural wine)
Cirrus (Barangaroo, Brent Savage — the best waterfront seafood)
10 William St (Paddington, Paddo's Italian wine bar, natural wine + pasta)
LP's Quality Meats (Chippendale, Luke Powell — house-cured, fire-cooked)
Billy Kwong (Potts Point, Kylie Kwong, Chinese-Australian — organic, community-focused)
Bather's Pavilion (Balmoral Beach, Serge Dansereau — the civilised beach club)
Bentley Restaurant + Bar (Surry Hills, Brent Savage — refined)
China Doll (Woolloomooloo Wharf, Frank Roberts — Pan-Asian, water views)
The Dolphin Hotel (Surry Hills, Riley St — pub wine bar with great food)
Cho Cho San (Potts Point, Jonathan Barthelmess — Japanese inspired)
Catalina (Rose Bay, water views + seafood)
Arthur (Surry Hills, natural wine focused)
Lotus (Potts Point, Dan Hong — the yum cha + late night)
